headline: Sammaan Capital Limited: Timely Interest Payment Certification on Listed Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures
sum: Sammaan Capital Limited certified to NSE that it has made timely payment of interest on its publicly-issued Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures (SRNCDs) listed on stock exchanges. The disclosure was filed under Regulation 57 of SEBI's Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements (LODR) Regulations, 2015.
detail: Sammaan Capital Limited, a financial services company, filed a regulatory intimation with NSE confirming that it had met all interest payment obligations on its publicly-issued Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures. The certification was required under Regulation 57 of SEBI's LODR Regulations, which mandates listed issuers to promptly disclose compliance with debt covenants and payment schedules. This filing is part of standard ongoing disclosure requirements for debenture-issuing companies and indicates the company's adherence to contractual and regulatory debt-servicing obligations.
